MVX A La Carte Bagger Gauges



Want to customize your MVX Instrument package?  You can do it with the new MVX Series Ala Carte Instruments!  Start with a Speedometer/Tachometer pair and build from there, whether you only need 4 gauges to make room for tweeters, or go full-bore at up to 7 for the ultimate in performance!

  • 31 individually user-selectable colors for Pointer, Backlight and LCD Message Center.
  • 4 Different face options available:
    Black with Gray Accents, White with Gray Accents
  • Chrome or Black bezel option

*All MVX Ala Carte Instruments require the use of an MVX-820x Speedometer/Tachometer pair, then build from there, up to 7 gauges! For additional digital readouts without adding a physical gauge, simply plug in an MBM module to add Boost, Air Pressure or Compass to the LCD Message Centers within the Speedometer and Tachometer.

Ala Carte Standard Instruments
MVX-8200 1996 - 2003 Speedometer and Tachometer
MVX-8204 2004 - 2013 Speedometer and Tachometer
MVX-8K-F Fuel Level Gauge
MVX-8K-O Oil Pressure Gauge
MVX-8K-T Oil Temp Gauge
MVX-8K-V Voltmeter
Auxiliary Gauges and Add-On Modules
MVX-8K-A  Air Pressure
* Requires:MBM-19 below, sold separately 
MBM-19

Pressure Module

  • Includes a single SEN-1901 pressure sender (rear air suspension)
  • If the application contains front & rear air suspension, add a second SEN-1901

MBM-19 may also be used without the MVX-8K-A to display Air Pressure within the LCD message centers of the MVX Spedometer and Tachometer. 
SEN-1901 0-300psi pressure sender for a second pressure reading
MVX-8K-B      Boost Pressure
  - Requires: MBM-09
MBM-09

Boost Module with sender

  • Required for MVX-8K-B

MBM-09 be also used without the MVX-8K-B to display Boost Pressure within the LCD message centers of the MVX Spedometer and Tachometer
MBM-17

GPS-Powered Compass and Altimeter Module

  • Offers a direct plug-in to any MVX Speedometer/Tachometer to display Compass Heading!
  • Want to display Outside Air Temperature too? Simply add the optional SEN-1701 Ambient Temp Sender for bikes without a stock Ambient Air Temp gauge or sender.
SEN-1701 Ambient Air Temp Sender for use with MBM-17.
